items.title: Java Cross-Border Payment Platform
items.description: Java local currency collection accounts through CoGoLinks, consolidation into JPMorgan or Citi, CNY funding from Chuzhou Bank, and worldwide payments under invoice.

items.title: Crescent AED & EUR Payment Hub
items.description: AED liquidity collection through Crescent at BOK International Abu Dhabi, followed by AED and EUR supplier payments across the UAE, Indonesia, Europe and Hong Kong.

items.title: Cross-Border Payment Platform
items.description: Local IDR and VND collection with FX conversion to CNY/CNH, plus direct USD or CNY/CNH funding for international B2B payments from Indonesia.

items.title: Mintai Fundamental Route
items.description: Liquidity route through Stable Vision or Quantum, with direct Mintai and Sunrate payment options.

items.title: Chuzhou Fundamental Route
items.description: White and Gray liquidity streams with direct and LianLian payment routes.

items.title: Indonesian Fundamental Route
items.description: Dubai liquidity from commodity traders through Nova General at Invest Bank to Indonesian companies and worldwide suppliers.

items.title: Dubai Route
items.description: Comparison of the prohibited same-bank structure and the correct cross-bank route to final suppliers.

items.title: Russia & International Agency Route
items.description: Parallel RUB agency settlements and foreign-currency liquidity route through an agent and sub-agent.

items.title: Emlak Bank Fundamental Road
items.description: Liquidity from Solid or other suppliers to XTrade or Teknik, with their respective Emlak Bank payment conditions.

items.title: Crypto Liquidity Agency Route
items.description: Alternative RUB-to-USDT route through crypto agents, followed by conversion into foreign-currency liquidity for final supplier payments.

items.title: ODI China–Overseas Group Structure
items.description: ODI-compliant ownership chain from a mainland Chinese company to overseas subsidiaries, with regulatory checkpoints and bank-onboarding context.
